'''Tail stinger wraps''' were items used by [[Raquor'daan/Legends|dark wolf]] handlers; dark wolves had a [[Tripion]]-like stinger on their tails. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]] and dark wolf handler [[Adazian Liebke]] carried several tail stinger wraps with him.
